# HelpMeTest

Friday evening, you ship a fix and close your laptop. Saturday 3am, checkout breaks, nobody knows. Monday, three customers gone. HelpMeTest is the AI watching while you sleep: it writes the test once, then runs it as deterministic automation, real browser, API and mobile vectors, unlimited parallel execution, CI/CD integration, 24/7 monitoring with 6-month history.

One command, no config, first test in five minutes. If you can describe what your customers do on your site ("check if checkout works"), you can use it, no CSS selectors required. Its CLI is built for AI agents and already names Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Usage-based pricing at $0.003/run: zero when idle, 14-day free trial to start.

Listed from the public site (helpmetest.com), not tested by Skill Harbor. Review before buying, as always.
